description: This file contains the FormulaTranslator class responsible for converting OpenOffice ODS formulas and cell addresses into Excel-compatible formats within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: FormulaTranslator
classes.description: Provides static methods to translate and convert formulas and cell references from OpenOffice ODS format to Excel format.

methods.name: convertToExcelAddressValue
methods.description: Converts an OpenOffice cell address string, including ranges and sheet references, into an Excel-compatible address string.

methods.name: convertToExcelFormulaValue
methods.description: Converts OpenOffice formulas into Excel-compatible formulas, handling reference translation, separator adjustment, and function/array syntax differences.
